title: Blessing of the Naaru (Part 1)
flavor: When their homeland was invaded, brutal aggressors sought to secure the loyalty of its inhabitants through knowledge and power. However, the Farseer foresaw a terrifying future where his people would be transformed into demons by the Burning Legion, unleashing endless slaughter. With the assistance of benevolent energy beings known as the 'Naaru,' the Farseer gathered like-minded individuals from his race and escaped their once-inhabited planet, becoming the Draenei. After numerous trials, they finally found a new home to settle, and the Draenei began to pursue a new destiny under the blessings of the Holy Light!

entries.name: Dark Seer ($2, Draenei/Warlock)
entries.detail: New chess piece. Ability: Ion Shell(Prioritizes casting on nearby allied units, does not stack). <Active Ability: Activates on Full Mana> Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it. The Dark Seer slices holes into the 'Land Behind the Wall,' causing prismatic energy to seep forth.

entries.name: Dawnbreaker($3, Draenei/Knight)
entries.detail: New chess piece. Ability: Fire wreath. <Active Ability: Activates on Full Mana> Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her. Across the vast lineage of star progeny, there were multitudes unwilling to align with the aims of the Children of Light. To those who dared organise defiance, the Children would dispatch Valora and her hammer to show a measure of their power--to leave the rebels either shattered or set back to rights.

entries.name: OmniKnight
entries.detail: Skill rework to <guardian angel> (consistent with the old version, providing group protection. Originally used <Purification> temporarily due to changes in DOTA2. The All-Seeing One casts down his protection over those that Purist calls friends.

entries.name: Tusk
entries.detail: Base attack interval reduced from 1.3 seconds to 1.2 seconds.

entries.name: New Race
entries.detail: Draenei <Race Abilities: Blessing of the Naaru> (2) Draenei: All friendly pieces gain effects: Whenever a cumulative total of more than 100 points of healing is taken it is split (cumulative healing) points of pure damage among the surrounding enemies. Note: The blessings have a range of 260; and will not trigger for a while if there are no enemies in range. Note: The blessings have a single damage limit of 400 and a cooldown of 2 seconds. To evade the Burning Legion's clutches, a congregation led by the Farseer fled their homelands, faithful to the Naaru and the Holy Light. They named themselves Draenei, the Exiled Ones.

entries.name: Undead - Plague
entries.detail: Effect fine-tuned (due to changes in the way undead pieces are obtained) (3) Undead: All non-undead pieces on both sides of the battle gain the plague effect: Maximum Health -10%. (6) Undead: All non-undead pieces on both sides of the battle gain the plague effect: Maximum Health -40%. (9) Undead: Plague-infected pieces that die in combat are reanimated as Skeleton Soldiers to fight for the enemy. Note: Melee chess pieces will be resurrected as Wraith King✪, while ranged chess pieces will be resurrected as Clinkz✪, with the same star level as the dead chess piece. Skeleton soldiers last for 10 seconds.

entries.name: Monk - Drunken Stagger
entries.detail: (2) (4) Monks' current damage now affects the triggering probability. The higher the damage, the higher the triggering probability (balancing low-frequency high damage and high-frequency low damage benefits, adjustment coefficient is sqrt(damage/100)).

entries.name: Knight - Divine Protection
entries.detail: (4) (6) The probability of knights to proc a shield is reduced from 30%/20% to 20%/10%.

entries.name: Warlock - Soul Leech
entries.detail: (4) The life steal ratio of warlocks is reduced from 25% to 20%, (6) The maximum health drained by warlocks is reduced from 50% to 30%.

entries.name: Pandaren - Hospitality
entries.detail: (1) (2) The probability of inviting Pandaren is balanced from 7%/10% to 6%/12%.

entries.name: Warrior - Fortified Armour
entries.detail: (6) The armour provided by warriors is increased from 9 to 12.

entries.name: Hunter - AimedShot
entries.detail: (6) The probability of hunters dealing an additional attack is increased from 40% to 50%.

entries.name: Priest - Salvation
entries.detail: The duration of Mind Control is now equal to the piece’s level × 2 (originally a fixed 10 seconds).

entries.name: Ascetic's Cap (T2) If the carriers survive a battle on the main field, starting from the next round, you will summon a random undead piece
entries.detail: New item. Note: Recruiting a random undead piece follows the probability of recruiting the piece for your current courier level. Note: A Recruited Undead Piece can fight for you, but it sells for 0. Note: The carrier will gain the Ascetic’s Cap effect at the start of the battle round, If the hat is given to the carrier midway through the battle, it will take effect in the next battle round. An austere hat thought to be of Turstarkuri origin.

entries.name: Divine Rapier
entries.detail: Besides increasing base attack damage, it also increases ability damage by 25% (synchronised with DOTA 2).

entries.name: Second Chance
entries.detail: While holding this relic, at the beginning of each round, reroll chess pieces can also be refreshed once for free.

entries.name: Mango Tree
entries.detail: Now the tree wilts after 8 drops, and grants an additional golden enchanted mango (originally 9 mangoes).

entries.name: WeaponSmith
entries.detail: While holding the relic, the weapon Smith himself will appear beside the chessboard (similar to Mango Tree, The Great Vault).

entries.name: WeaponSmith
entries.detail: Now, after recasting 2 pieces of Spoil tokens, the weapon Smith will disappear(originally able to recast 3 times).

entries.name: Rambling FateBender
entries.detail: Now, undead cannot be used as an additional race. (Similar to Human, Pandaren, Mech and Druid).

entries.name: UI Optimization
entries.detail: Now, the remaining rounds before expiration will be displayed at the current relic icon (on the right side of the courier's inventory).
